headline: HuyenBao v11.42 — gộp sleep+asset+income vào dashboard PinZone, thiết kế lại 2 cột dễ đọc
summary: DASHBOARD MERGE. The sleep schedule + asset breakdown chart + income breakdown (the 3 cards the user showed in the screenshot) are now MERGED into the PinZone sticky dashboard. Everything the player needs at a glance is in ONE pinned card. New 2-column grid layout: left column = character identity + health/spirit/XP bars; right column = sleep schedule dropdown + asset breakdown bar chart with color-coded legend + income breakdown rows. Asset chart colors improved: gold (cash), teal (stocks), blue (property), bronze (business), purple (bank), coral (collectibles) — distinct, readable, color-blind-friendly. Removed the 3 duplicate cards from HomeTab. Mobile: 2-column grid collapses to 1 column.
features: MERGED: sleep schedule + asset breakdown + income breakdown into PinZone sticky dashboard
2-COLUMN GRID: left = identity + bars; right = sleep + asset chart + income
ASSET CHART COLORS: gold/teal/blue/bronze/purple/coral — distinct, readable, color-blind-friendly
SLEEP: dropdown inline in PinZone (was separate card in HomeTab)
INCOME: compact rows with green +amounts (was separate card)
REMOVED: 3 duplicate cards from HomeTab (sleep, asset, income)
MOBILE: 2-column grid collapses to 1 column under 700px
PinZone now accepts `act` prop (for sleep schedule change)
